articles.title: Bitcoin, copper, stocks, yields all fall; gold rises
Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

articles.title: Australia’s financial watchdog seeks stiffer rules for crypto exchanges ahead of licensing deadline
articles.snippet: The country’s regulator, ASIC, has proposed tougher rules to protect users’ digital assets, crypto trading and to safeguard the country’s financial stability.

articles.title: EasyA hits $1.1 billion valuation, targets 2027 public listing and tokenized shares
articles.snippet: The blockchain and AI developer platform has completed two years of audits and wants its shares available onchain from the first day of trading.

articles.title: Former FTX Europe chief targets U.S. tokenized stock trading with new SEC exemption
articles.snippet: Nasdaq-listed Perpetuals.com is the second company to pursue a U.S. tokenized stock marketplace under the SEC's new framework, following a joint venture between OKX and NYSE parent ICE.
